t.why: The world's largest copper producer and a major lithium producer.
t.rel: A country more than 4,000 km long from north to south. Bolivia, which says it lost its coastline to Chile in a 19th-century war, has long demanded access to the sea.
t.korea: In 2004 it became the first country to sign a free trade agreement with Korea. Korea imports a lot of its copper.
t.know: The Atacama Desert is the driest place on Earth outside the poles, so many of the world's big observatories are there.
t.etext: The world's largest copper producer, which also mines a lot of lithium. It sells farm and sea products such as salmon, wine and cherries. An open economy with free trade agreements with many countries.
